schemes.Name: Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme)
schemes.Description: Financial assistance scheme to encourage female students from Tamil Nadu Government schools to pursue higher education without financial constraints.
Benefits: Monthly financial aid of ₹1,000 directly credited to the student's bank account.
Coverage extends across Degree, Diploma, ITI, and professional courses until completion.
Reduces financial barriers and higher education dropout rates for women.

Eligibility.School Education: Must have studied Class 6 to Class 12 in Tamil Nadu Government Schools
Eligibility.Course Enrollment: Enrolled in undergraduate degree, diploma, ITI, or professional course

Documents: College Admission Fee Receipt & Student ID Card
schemes.Application Process: Students can apply online via the official Pudhumai Penn (Penkalvi) portal or through designated nodal officers in their respective colleges.
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu - August 2026

schemes.Name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam
schemes.Description: Flagship basic income support scheme providing direct financial aid of ₹1,000 per month to eligible women heads of households across Tamil Nadu.
Benefits: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) of ₹1,000 per month into bank accounts.
Provides financial independence and livelihood security to over 1 crore women.
No middleman intervention with transparent digital transfer.

Eligibility.Land Holding: Wetland less than 5 acres or dry land less than 10 acres
Eligibility.Residency: Resident of Tamil Nadu with valid Smart Ration Card

Documents: Tamil Nadu Smart Family Card (Ration Card)
schemes.Application Process: Applications are collected during special camps conducted at local ration shops/e-Sevai centers across Tamil Nadu.
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Special Programme Implementation Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu - August 2026

schemes.Name: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit Scheme
schemes.Description: Maternal health and financial assistance scheme aimed at providing financial support and nutrition kits to poor pregnant women in Tamil Nadu.
Benefits: Total financial assistance of ₹18,000 disbursed in 5 installments.
2 Nutrition Kits valued at ₹4,000 containing health supplements, iron syrup, and nutrition mix.
Ensures institutional delivery and proper antenatal care.

Eligibility.Residency: Resident of Tamil Nadu registered in PICME portal

Documents: PICME (Pregnancy and Infant Cohort Monitoring and Evaluation) RCH ID Card
schemes.Application Process: Register pregnancy within 12 weeks at local Village Health Nurse (VHN) or Urban Health Nurse (UHN) / Primary Health Centre (PHC).
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Health and Family Welfare Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu - August 2026

schemes.Name: Naan Mudhalvan Skill Development Scheme
schemes.Description: Comprehensive skill enhancement and career guidance initiative for students and youth in Tamil Nadu to make them globally competitive and industry-ready.
Benefits: Free industry-aligned training in AI, Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Coding, Robotics, and Soft Skills.
Free access to top global learning platforms (Coursera, Infosys Springboard, etc.).
Direct placement drives and internship connections with leading corporate companies.

Eligibility.Target Group: School and College Students (Arts, Science, Engineering, Polytechnic, ITI) & Unemployed Youth

schemes.Application Process: Students can register online via the official Naan Mudhalvan portal or access courses through their college portal integration.
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Tamil Nadu Skill Development Corporation (TNSDC) - August 2026

schemes.Name: Tamil Nadu Free Laptop Scheme for Students
schemes.Description: Welfare scheme providing free laptops to students in Government and Government-aided institutions to facilitate digital learning and tech literacy.
Benefits: Free branded laptop preloaded with educational software, operating system, and study tools.
Enables digital learning, online research, and technical skill development.

Eligibility.Target Group: Students of Class 11 & 12 in Government and Aided Schools, and Arts, Science, Polytechnic & Engineering College students
Eligibility.Institution: Government and Government-aided schools & colleges in Tamil Nadu

Documents: School / College Roll Number & Student ID Card
schemes.Application Process: No individual application required; eligible students are identified directly through school and college administration lists.
schemes.Source / Last Updated: School Education Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu - August 2026

schemes.Name: Chief Minister’s Girl Child Protection Scheme
schemes.Description: Social welfare scheme promoting education of girl children, discouraging female infanticide, and preventing child marriage through long-term financial deposits.
Benefits: Scheme I: Fixed deposit of ₹50,000 for families with only 1 girl child.
Scheme II: Fixed deposit of ₹25,000 each for families with 2 girl children.
Maturity amount with interest released when the girl reaches 18 years of age after completing Class 10.

Eligibility.Family Structure: Families with 1 or 2 girl children and no male child
Eligibility.Sterilization Condition: One parent must have undergone sterilization before 35 years of age
Eligibility.Income Limit: Family annual income below ₹72,000 per annum
Eligibility.Residency: Resident of Tamil Nadu for minimum 10 years

Documents: Income Certificate from Village Administrative Officer (VAO)
schemes.Application Process: Apply at the District Social Welfare Office or Block Development Office (BDO) within 3 years of the child's birth.
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Department of Social Welfare & Women Empowerment, Tamil Nadu - August 2026

schemes.Name: Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme (UYEGP)
schemes.Description: State credit-linked subsidy scheme encouraging micro-enterprise creation among unemployed youth in manufacturing, service, and trading sectors.
Benefits: Project cost support up to ₹15 Lakhs for manufacturing and ₹5 Lakhs for service/business activities.
Government Capital Subsidy of 25% of the project cost (max ₹1.25 Lakhs).
Low promoter contribution (5% for special category / women, 10% for general).

Eligibility.Age: 18 to 45 years (relaxation up to 45 years for women, SC/ST, BC/MBC, Divyangjan)
Eligibility.Family Income: Family income not exceeding ₹5 Lakhs per annum
Eligibility.Residency: Resident of Tamil Nadu for minimum 3 years

schemes.Application Process: Apply online through the District Industries Centre (DIC) portal (msmeonline.tn.gov.in/uyegp).
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) Department, Tamil Nadu - August 2026

schemes.Name: New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS)
schemes.Description: Assistance scheme for educated first-generation entrepreneurs to establish commercial production enterprises in Tamil Nadu.
Benefits: Project cost financing from ₹10 Lakhs up to ₹5 Crores.
25% Capital Subsidy on project cost (maximum limit up to ₹75 Lakhs).
3% Interest Subvention throughout the loan repayment tenure.

Eligibility.Age: 21 to 45 years (up to 45 years for Women, SC/ST, BC/MBC)
Eligibility.Education: Degree, Diploma, ITI, or Vocational Training qualification

Documents: Land / Lease Agreement for business premises
schemes.Application Process: Submit application online via MSME Online TN portal and attend District Level Selection Committee (DLSC) interview.
schemes.Source / Last Updated: MSME Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu - August 2026

schemes.Name: Sathyavani Muthu Ammaiyar Ninaivu Free Supply of Sewing Machines Scheme
schemes.Description: Social welfare scheme to empower destitute women, widows, deserted wives, and physically handicapped women by supplying free motor-operated sewing machines.
Benefits: Free power-operated / motor-driven sewing machine.
Enables home-based self-employment and sustainable monthly income.

Eligibility.Gender: Female (Widows, Destitute Women, Deserted Wives, Differently Abled)
Eligibility.Skills: Must possess tailoring training certificate from recognized institute

schemes.Application Process: Submit hard copy application form along with certificates to District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO) or e-Sevai center.
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Department of Social Welfare & Women Empowerment, Tamil Nadu - August 2026

schemes.Name: Chief Minister’s Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
schemes.Description: Universal health coverage scheme providing cashless medical and surgical treatment to low-income families in government and private empanelled hospitals.
Benefits: Cashless medical coverage up to ₹5,000,000 per family per year.
Covers 1,500+ medical procedures, surgeries, organ transplants, and critical care.
Includes diagnostic tests and post-hospitalization follow-up care.

Eligibility.Target Group: Families registered under Tamil Nadu Smart Ration Card
Eligibility.Income Limit: Annual family income less than ₹1,20,000 (or listed on Smart Ration Card)

Documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Income Certificate (if ration card status requires income verification)
schemes.Application Process: Enrolment camps held at District Collectorates; card issued at Kiosk after biometric verification.
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Tamil Nadu Health Systems Project, Health and Family Welfare Department - August 2026

schemes.Name: Chief Minister’s Breakfast Scheme
schemes.Description: Nutritional welfare initiative supplying free healthy breakfast to primary school children in Government schools across Tamil Nadu.
Benefits: Free hot cooked nutritious breakfast (upma, kichadi, pongal with sambar) served every school day.
Combats childhood malnutrition, improves classroom attendance, and enhances learning capacity.

Eligibility.Institution: All Government primary and middle schools in Tamil Nadu

schemes.Application Process: Automatically provided to all enrolled Class 1–5 students in Tamil Nadu Government schools; no separate registration required.
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department - August 2026

schemes.Name: Tamil Nadu Rural Transformation Project (TNRTP / Vazhndhu Kaattuvoom)
schemes.Description: Rural enterprise promotion project targeting women-led Self Help Groups (SHGs) to promote micro-enterprises, financial linkages, and collective business enterprises.
Benefits: Matching grant up to 30% for women enterprise startup and expansion.
Community Skill Schools training and business mentoring.
Direct access to bank linkage, Revolving Fund, and Producer Group grants.

Eligibility.Target Group: Women Self Help Group (SHG) members, rural women entrepreneurs, Producer Groups
Eligibility.Location: Rural Panchayats covered under TNRTP blocks in Tamil Nadu

Documents: SHG Membership ID / Book of Records
schemes.Application Process: Contact Block Level Executive Committee (BLEC) or Village Poverty Reduction Committee (VPRC) office.
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Department of Rural Development and Panchayat Raj, Tamil Nadu - August 2026
